# Channel is the place where humans connect.

We redesigned email, messaging and social media around a single core belief that all content on Channel must be created within the app. So no AI generated writing, photos, or videos are allowed on the platform.

Every account here must belong to a real person which is verified when you sign up with a government ID and a selfie.

We made the app familiar and comfortable by design. You can message a friend , send an email , post a photo or video , and write long form articles .

When you sign up for Channel you get an @channel.is email address. This lets you send anyone an email that includes a verified signature letting recipients know your message was written by a human, not ai. No cold external inbound emails are sent to your account.

Channel is currently free. There are no ads, and the feed can be selected to chronological.

# Organizations pay to be here.

Channel has no ads, paid reach, or boosted posts. People use it for free and we require every organization page to be controlled by verified humans on the platform.

An Organization page on Channel gives people a place to find you , follow you , and connect in a way that isn't possible on other platforms. You can verify your employees in the app and have authentic control over your brand. Organization page's are allowed to post once a day to their followers and reply to users + customers via the messenger feature in the app.

Channel will be the best place for businesses to build real relationships with their customers and share authentic brand content to the world.
